narrative.overview: Bright ocean blue and turquoise make the Thai public dashboard approachable, while white working panels keep measurements and explanations readable. This replaces the earlier quiet coastal desk identity under the user’s redesign request.
keyCharacteristics: Map and point inspector form one working surface.
Four tinted measurement buttons distinguish wave, wind, rain, and sea temperature.
Interactive dates and charts share the selected point and day.
Technical methods remain available through readable disclosures.

rules.name: The Evidence Colour Rule
rules.body: Every map colour must retain its layer-specific legend, unit or class label, and source context. Activity labels include words as well as colour.

dos: Do keep units, selected day, coordinates and source dates near results.
Do use the same class colours in map and related overview.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced motion, and mobile/iframe provenance.
donts: Don’t turn missing data into zero or a favourable activity judgement.
Don’t present screening as accident probability, a validated tourism index, or permission to sail.
Don’t describe SST as air temperature, water safety, or a climate anomaly.
